content.description: 25 high-fantasy characters in a painted anime/JRPG style, with per-character full-body art, upper-body/portrait crops, pose variants, and some shadowed versions at high resolution (roughly 300-2400 px). Cast includes knights, mages, angels, an archer, a gunner, dancers, a cook and armoured adventurers. Also five 1920x1080 painted backgrounds: town square, arena, tavern interior, ruins and a meadow. Best for visual-novel portraits, RPG party art, dialogue busts and key art rather than small sprites.
